evidence: Calls attribute_context_status_value_get for selectors 0x3f, 0x13, 0x53, and 0x48. It forms two output condition bits: one requires selector 0x3f equal 2 and selector 0x13 not equal 4; the other is true when selector 0x48 is positive, or when selector 0x53 is 1..4 and (selector 0x3f is 3 or selector 0x13 is not 6). It returns the OR of those bits (decompiled/main/main_0006.c:33789-33832). Caller consumes the result as a condition while deriving a stored status value (decompiled/main/main_0125.c:25010-25018).

Looks up the status-indexed entry in the global table rooted at 0x7004650760; for a found entry it adds the bytes at entry offsets 0 and 0x1c. If attribute_context_status_matches succeeds, it also adds the result of f_70007461b0(status), which scans 24 indexed context records and counts matching subfields (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:14416-14440; helper scan main_0055.c:43057-43153). The caller adds one to this return value before using it as an attribute-processing count (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:27450-27455).

When the optional enable argument and string pointer are present, passes the input string and the exact literal "0" at 0x7001d1754a to import thunk f_7001c1fb60, then uses its return to choose between status selector 2 and selector 1. Missing input takes the selector-2 path. It packages the chosen status and a 0/1 flag and calls the global dispatch helper with index 0x72 (decompiled/main/main_0035.c:13469-13496; literal resolved from main NSO rodata).

If the two helper lookups succeed, obtains a 16-bit value through f_70008bbc30, reads the existing signed byte at the input record’s offset 0x3ec, writes the low byte of the returned value there, and passes the value plus a changed/not-changed flag to populate_and_sort_attribute_records. The helper’s branch-specific value meaning is not inferred (decompiled/main/main_0083.c:1161-1179; callee f_70008bbc30 dispatch and output store at main_0064.c:1120-1172).

Initializes a temporary container, obtains the global context-entry collection, and loops over the returned count. Each iteration computes a per-index value and calls the accepted helper set_global_context_entry_flag_0x78_with_status_13_index_override with that value and a zero override argument; then it advances the index and repeats (decompiled/main/main_0087.c:48935-48958). Its indexed caller invokes it from the context-entry traversal at main_0087.c:48569-48573.
